_comment: Topic-based discovery engines for the discovery-worker. The same SearchRequest shape is used for every network; 'network' on the request selects which block below is queried. surface/deep engines are fetched over plain HTTP, dark engines over the Tor SOCKS5 client. Engine 'type' is one of: searxng_json (SearXNG JSON API) or html_links (generic anchor extraction from a results page).

engines.name: searxng
engines._comment: Requires a self-hosted SearXNG instance with the JSON format enabled. Enable and set base_url, or leave disabled and rely on the html_links engines.

engines.name: ahmia
engines._comment: Clearnet gateway that indexes .onion services; fetched through Tor like the rest of the dark network.

engines.name: torch
engines._comment: Historically unreliable; left disabled so the dark list fails over to ahmia only.
